prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:

If you want names/phone numbers I can look them up, but I don’t have live web access unless you want me to generate search queries you can paste into Google. Meanwhile, here are reliable next steps and what to look for:

Where to check now
- City of Liberty Utilities: many cities maintain a list or rules for approved/certified backflow testers and how to submit annual test results. Contact your water department or check the city website.
- Local plumbing companies and irrigation contractors: many do backflow assembly testing and repairs. Search Google Maps or Yelp for “backflow testing Liberty MO” or “backflow tester Kansas City area.”
- National/local chains: companies such as Roto-Rooter and local plumbing/irrigation firms in the Kansas City/Liberty area often offer testing and repair.
- Trade directories: Angi (Angie’s List), HomeAdvisor, and Yelp for reviews and recent customer experiences.

What to ask any contractor before hiring
- Are you a certified backflow assembly tester (BAT)? Ask for their certification number and issuing authority.
- Do you have experience with the specific type/brand of assembly I have?
- Will you provide the official test report form the city requires and submit it to Liberty (if required)?
- Do you carry liability insurance and offer a warranty on repairs?
- Estimated cost: typical annual test is often $50–$150; repairs are extra (parts + labor).
- Availability and timeline for repairs (same-day vs. scheduled).

Sample quick script to call/email
“Hi — I need annual testing/possible repair of a backflow prevention device at my property in Liberty, MO. Are you a certified backflow assembly tester? Can you provide your certification number, an estimate for testing, and whether you handle the city submission of the test report? Also, do you have availability this week?”
